Fabulous Brunch location in District 1
Sep 2024 • Friends
A trip to Saigon would not be complete without a visit to my favourite French brunch cafe on Lê Thánh Tôn, District 1. Western style brunches but made with the freshest sustainably sourced ingredients.

This morning I introduced a friend from Da Nang to the lovely breakfasts here. He had the salmon eggs benedict for the first time in his life and absolutely loved it. I stayed with an old favourite the L’Usinse big breakfast. I just love those delicious Montclair sausages!

Service was spot on, the atmosphere is totally relaxing and the tables nicely spaced out. Well worth at least one visit. Or like I do, just keep on coming back!

P.S. They do fabulous lunches and main meals as well. This visit was just for brunch.

A Vietnamese Culinary Gem with Stellar Service!
Sep 2024 • Solo
An amazing restaurant, L’Usine Le Thanh Ton delivers. 
From the moment you step in, youre captivated by the cool, modern ambiance that blend with traditional Vietnamese elements. Then there’s the service. I always say everything starts with the right people, that greatness begins with people that really care, that are really smart, and that passionately deliver the promise of the brand. This team, this group, is top-notch from start to finish. Led by manager (his name is Duc) his staff were friendly, welcoming, and extremely knowledgeable about the menu. They guided me through their offerings, suggesting dishes that showcased the best of Vietnamese cuisine. And for the food—what an absolute treat. Every dish was flavorful, beautifully presented, presentation as stunning as the taste, it was clear that each dish was crafted with care and expertise.
L’Usine offers a dining experience not to be missed. The combination of amazing food, a cool staff that delivers impeccable service, and a stylish setting makes this restaurant a true standout. I can’t wait to return to explore more of their delicious menu!
Thank you so much Duc and Team!!
